chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, that he said: I was told by Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Uthman, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja‘far, from his father, from his fathers, peace be upon them, that they said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, chose from the lands four, and so He, Exalted and Glorious is He, said: «And by the Fig, Olive, the Mountain of Seeneen and this Safe Land.» The Fig is Medina, the Olive is Jerusalem, the Mountain of Seeneen is Kufa, and the Safe Land is Mecca.

key_terms.طُورُ سِينِينَ: The Mountain of Seeneen (interpreted as Kufa)

ai.seo_question: What are the four lands chosen by Allah according to the interpretation of Surah At-Tin?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar* offers a unique geographical tafsir of the oaths in Surah At-Tin, elevating Kufa to the status of 'Mount Sinai' to highlight its spiritual significance in Shia tradition. By linking these four cities—Medina, Jerusalem, Kufa, and Mecca—to divine selection, the hadith underscores their collective role as centers of prophetic and imamic authority. This interpretation reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of specific lands chosen by God for guidance and revelation.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, that he said: I was told by Abu Abdillah al-Razi, from Hasan bin Ali bin Abi Uthman, from Musa bin Bikr, from Abu’l-Hasan, Musa bin Ja’far, from his father, from his fathers, peace be upon them, that he said: The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said:

Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, chose from the lands, four, and so He, Exalted and Glorious is He, said: «And by the Fig, Olive, the Mountain of Seeneen and this Safe Land.» (95:1-3) The Fig is Medina, the Olive is Jerusalem, the Mountain of Seeneen is Kufa, and the Safe Land is Mecca.
